commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Garcia (Betis) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Giovani Lo Celso is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Perez Guerrero (Betis).
89' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
85' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement.
85' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' Alvaro Valles pulls off a brilliant save! Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. Celta Vigo have a corner.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
82' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) but poses no threat.
80' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' The foul by Pablo Garcia (Betis) was seen by Jesus Manzano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
79' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
74' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
74' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.
72' Substitution. Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is replaced by Iago Aspas.
72' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is given a rest as he is replaced by Bryan Zaragoza.
72' Cucho Hernandez goes off the pitch and Valentin Gomez (Betis) comes on.
72' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
72' It's time for a substitution. Chimy Avila (Betis) comes on in place of Sergi Altimira.
69' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
67' A substitution has been made. Borja Iglesias is replaced by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo).
64' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Mihailo Ristic will be replaced by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo).
57' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.
56' Pablo Fornals (Betis) brings his opponent down. Jesus Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Aitor Ruibal is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pablo Garcia (Betis).
53' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
52' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
50' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

47' 1 - 1 Goal! Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the middle of the net. Alvaro Valles is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
47' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

46' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Alvaro Valles with a fabulous save.
46' The ball goes behind for a corner. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Javier Rueda comes on the pitch for Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45' 0 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Giovani Lo Celso from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Marc Bartra (Betis), who planted a long-range header inside the right post to make the score 0:1.
45' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner.

45' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
44' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
44' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.

43' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
41' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.

37' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
37' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Ionut Radu comes off his line to intercept.
36' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
34' Sergi Altimira (Betis) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
34' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
31' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
29' Looks like Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
28' Pablo Fornals (Betis) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

27' A cross by Cucho Hernandez (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
22' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Aitor Ruibal (Betis). Jesus Manzano saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
22' Wasted opportunity! Hector Bellerin (Betis) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
20' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

19' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Alvaro Valles was alert and the score remained the same.
18' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
17' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
16' Excellent touch by Cucho Hernandez (Betis)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
12' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
12' A lofted cross from Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
11' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Jesus Manzano is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
